column1: # site_rules.tsv - the one table of per-file upload rules (providers/aws/ops/site/site_deploy.sh).
# One rule per line, three fields separated by a TAB: glob, Content-Type, Cache-Control.
# The glob is matched against the file's path from the site's root (no leading slash), and * crosses /.
# The first rule that matches wins.
# A product's own table (SITE_RULES, the same format) is read before this one, so its rules win.
# Cache-Control is a header value, or one of two words:
#               a browser revalidates every time (no-cache); CloudFront holds the file until the
#               deploy's invalidation, a day at most if one is ever missed
# A file under a content-hashed glob (SITE_HASHED) is immutable whatever its rule says, but html,
# CloudFront compresses only the types on its list ("Serve compressed files" in the CloudFront
# developer guide), and only objects of 1,000 to 10,000,000 bytes.
# application/wasm is on the list, so a separate .wasm (the opt-out from a UI framework that
# bundles the module into the page) is compressed at the edge up to 10 MB, and sent as stored above.
